thread:
Sam: Heads up — staging is seeing intermittent 503s hitting the embeddings gateway since 22:10 UTC. Root cause looks like a regression in the tokenization layer in v2.1.4.
Elaine: Yikes. Any P0 impact to customers?
Sam: Not yet in prod; only staging and a couple of internal canaries. But it breaks batched embedding jobs and causes retries. Want to push a hotfix (v2.1.4+hotfix.1) out of window.
Mohit: Can we validate perf quickly? What's the minimal rollout?
Sam: Plan: build hotfix image with tokenizer revert, pin model-serving container to sha:abc123hotfix, canary 5% on eu-west1, 20min smoke then 40% if green. Manual rollback knob ready.
Beth: Are there any DB migrations or config changes?
Sam: No migrations. Config diff: toggled tokenizer_compat = true. I put the short release note below.
Sam: ```release-notes
v2.1.4+hotfix.1
- Revert tokenization change that caused empty embeddings for some inputs
- No schema changes
- Expected latency/throughput identical to v2.1.4
```
Elaine: OK. We need expedited approvals from oncall + product for out-of-window. OpsOnCall can you weigh in on risk?
OpsOnCall: risk low to medium. Canary will surface regressions. My rollback steps: 1) abort canary 2) shift traffic back to v2.1.4. 3) if rollback fails, failover to read-only mode for embeddings via feature flag.
DeployBot: Deploy request received: image=service:v2.1.4-hotfix1, target=staging->eu-west1, canary=5%, wait=20m. Use /deploy approve to proceed.
Mohit: Quick test checklist: run unit tokenizer tests (done), run small embedding job (in prod-sim queue) — started now.
Beth: Product is OK with hotfix in staging but wants notice before prod. Notify CS if we promote.
Elaine: I'm +1 for staging patch. Does legal/security need to sign off?
Sam: No customer data changes. Security: minimal. I've pinged security channel for FYI.
Mohit: Small embedding job results: PASS, no regressions in output length distribution.
OpsOnCall: I approve expedited staging deploy. If canary is clean, can we set a 2-hour hold before prod promotion to let metrics bake?
Sam: Yes — propose hold window 2 hours and smoke tests: 1) 99th latency on embeddings under threshold 2) error rate <0.1% 3) KV cache hit rate consistent.
Elaine: Elaine approves for staging. @DeployBot go ahead.
DeployBot: /deploy start staging eu-west1 image=service:v2.1.4-hotfix1 canary=5% initiated by Sam. ETA canary stable: 22:45 UTC.
DeployBot: Canary progress: 1/4 pods rolled, 4/4 pods rolled, health checks passing.
Sam: rolling smoke now, running automated prompt set A against canary.
Mohit: Automated evals green. Latency steady.
Beth: Notifying CS: "Planned staging hotfix deploy in eu-west1; no prod impact yet."
OpsOnCall: Canary observed no 503s in 30m window. Approve ramp to 40%.
DeployBot: Ramping canary to 40% — applying traffic split.
DeployBot: Ramp complete. All health checks green. No new errors.
Elaine: Good. We hold for 2 hours per plan. Sam, track metrics and post final sign-off for prod.
Sam: Will do. If anything spikes, we'll abort and rollback to v2.1.4.
Beth: Thanks all. Postmortem if any surprises. :thumbsup:
